race.comment: SUMMER HAIL (2) has shown good improvement at her last two starts, hitting the frame latest when 2nd at this track over 350m. Goes well out of this box with a win and three minor placings. Key chance in this line up. WILD VENUS (1) wasn't far away at the finish when 4th and beaten only 2.5 lengths (20.25) at this track. Solid record here at the distance winning 11 races. Bold showing expected. WINE LOVER (8) missed the frame latest when fifth at this track (20.06) but was a winner four back in the best time of the program. Form here at the trip sound including five wins. Great chance to atone. SHOW BOAT JOHNNY (4) cannot be underestimated.
